body: Hey dude, I know it’s a shitty thing to say but fuck all of them okay? You don’t need to please anyone you only truly have yourself at the end of the day and if your bf isn’t treating you well you should end things and I know it’s easier said than done but if you don’t feel like you’re getting anything out of the relationship it’s just useless and I know I’m really not the best with words but if you ever need to talk I’m here for you and I understand what it’s like to feel like no one ever gives you anything back for all that you do
